description.value: Frankie's Jazz Club bills itself as Vancouver's premier live music venue, hosting seven jazz shows weekly from Wednesday through Sunday in the Georgian Court Hotel on Beatty Street. The venue runs a curated late-night After Dark series every Friday and Saturday featuring local and visiting jazz artists. It offers a full dinner menu alongside its music programming, making it a destination evening out for a touring cyclist exploring downtown Vancouver's cultural scene.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 57m; stands (2 spaces) at 61m; stands (2 spaces) at 75m; stands (2 spaces) at 78m; bollard (2 spaces) at 85m; bollard (2 spaces) at 87m; stands (2 spaces) at 89m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms Frankie's Jazz Club is an active live music venue in Vancouver's Georgian Court Hotel, with a dinner menu and a regular After Dark late-night jazz series. Contact details (phone 604-688-6368, address 755 Beatty Street Vancouver BC V6B 2M4) match OSM exactly, and the site was recently checked (OSM check_date 2026-03-25). No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, showers, racks, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those fields remain null; food/drink is confirmed via the Dinner Menu and After Dark Menu navigation items.
concerns: Venue is located inside the Georgian Court Hotel (per website contact page) — not a standalone building; cyclists should be aware of hotel parking/access context.
OSM address omits postal code; website provides full postal code V6B 2M4 — address field updated to website version.
No cycling amenities (bike parking, racks) confirmed from website; OSM wheelchair=yes tag not corroborated by website but not contradicted either.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Frankie's Jazz Club is a legitimate and active cultural attraction that touring cyclists might enjoy, but it has no confirmed cycling infrastructure (no bike parking, racks, or cyclist amenities mentioned) and is an evening/ticketed music venue — borderline fit for a WWC directory that typically highlights cyclist-service-oriented stops. A human reviewer should decide whether entertainment-only attractions are in scope.
enrichment_extras.notes: The After Dark series on Fridays and Saturdays starts at 11pm with a $10 cover at the door (walk-ins only for that series). Artist booking inquiries go to bookings@frankies.ca.
